decisions.executionNote: Begin symmetric elbow-up approach, raising wrists slightly while tilting fingers downward; target left car and right chocolate.
Finish downward wrist orientation and align open grippers over white car and right purple chocolate; defer descent until alignment is visible.
Descend onto aligned white car and right chocolate, then close both grippers; grasp depth estimated from RGB and link6 offset.
Stop deeper descent at observed contact height, finish closing and lift gently to inspect whether car and chocolate are retained.
Both objects appear retained. Lift above basket rims and carry car toward white left basket, chocolate toward red right basket.
Replan after continuity guard: smaller forward steps with slight lowering for reach margin, keeping both objects closed in grippers.
Release visible car over left basket and chocolate over right basket, then retreat slowly from the reach boundary.
Approach remaining left chocolate and far-right brown watch with separate arms; plan center staging for chocolate rather than crossing arms.
Refine centering and descend to grasp left chocolate and brown watch, then close without further downward loading.
Finish closing on chocolate and watch; lift vertically before lateral transport and inspect retention.
Chocolate is retained; move it toward center staging on left side. Brown watch was not lifted, so reopen and correct its approach toward its shifted center.
Chocolate slipped and is on table; return left gripper to it. Fine-center right gripper on brown watch, close and test a small lift.
Regrasp chocolate slightly deeper. Brown watch center grasp missed; target its near watch-face/band rather than the open loop.
Slow test lift with both grippers commanded closed; inspect whether brown watch is truly retained before transporting.
Carry retained chocolate to near-center staging without crossing; move retained brown watch toward middle basket with depth separation.
Set chocolate at center-line staging for right-arm pickup. Carry brown watch over right portion of middle basket, lowering slightly for reach margin.
Retract left after center staging. Replan right in small increments, tilting held watch into middle basket while avoiding further wrist extension.
Release brown watch inside middle basket. Left approaches remaining left watch; right retreats toward center-staged chocolate with separated workspaces.
Brown watch is visible in blue basket. Use reduced right retreat increments after guard, while aligning left gripper over the left watch.
Close left on watch at table height; right approaches staged chocolate from its own side, passing behind the yellow car.
Test-lift left watch away from center. Right makes a small forward/depth correction and closes on staged chocolate without crossing center.
Carry left watch toward middle basket with slight forward tilt for reach. Lift right chocolate then move toward right basket, keeping arms separated.
Both recent grasps appear lost: watch caught near basket front, chocolate slipped. Reopen and approach their visible new table positions, correcting left wrist tilt.
Guard rejected zero steps. Bridge left wrist toward last accepted orientation while opening and lifting clear; right reapproaches slipped chocolate.
Recenter right on chocolate's shifted position before closing. Return left to vertical over the fallen watch near blue basket front.
Close on left watch and lift away from basket lip before carrying. Test right chocolate retention with a straight slow lift.
Raise retained left watch clear of rim before advancing. Right chocolate remained on table; retry at a slightly deeper contact height.
Advance raised left watch into middle basket with additional gentle tilt and reach margin. Finish closing then test-lift right chocolate.
Release raised silver watch inside blue basket and withdraw left. Recenter right grasp forward on chocolate's current location before closing.
Withdraw empty left arm to its own workspace. Lift right chocolate slowly without lateral motion to verify the corrected grasp.
Chocolate remains on table. Correct table-height estimate, align jaws perpendicular to its long axis, and center a lower grasp; left waits clear.
Test the axis-aligned chocolate grasp with a vertical lift while maintaining closed command.
Chocolate now remains between jaws during lift. Carry it toward the right red basket while maintaining the successful grasp orientation.
Advance retained chocolate over red basket with small forward increments and mild tilt, leaving reach margin.
Release second chocolate into red basket, then retreat right toward remaining black watch while restoring grasp orientation.
Approach remaining black watch at its near face/band, restore downward jaws, and close at table grasp height.
Finish closing on black watch and lift straight up for retention and basket-rim clearance.
Black watch was not retained. Reopen and shift grasp forward/right onto the loop body before closing again.
Complete black-watch closure and lift vertically for visible retention and rim clearance.
Carry retained black watch over the right side of the middle basket, tilting forward while maintaining rim clearance and reach margin.
Release third watch into middle basket, then approach yellow car from the right, aligning jaws for center-line staging.
Align right jaws across yellow car, descend to side-grasp height and close; left remains clear for later center-line pickup.
Lift yellow car straight up with closed gripper to verify retention before staging it at the center boundary.
Carry retained yellow car to center-line staging on the right boundary and lower gently; left stays out until right retreats.
Set yellow car down at center, retract right into its workspace, and begin left approach only after release with matching jaw alignment.
Approach staged car with left at the center boundary; adjust to its new angle. Retract empty right arm toward its origin, well away from pickup.
Tilt left fingertips slightly onto the center-staged car without crossing the arm, close and test a small lift. Finish right-arm return toward origin.
Car appears secured in left jaws; lift above rim height and begin leftward carry. Settle right arm precisely at its origin.
Transport retained yellow car toward the left basket at raised clearance height; right remains reset and open.
Advance the retained yellow car over the white basket with gentle forward tilt and small increments, preserving reach margin.
Release yellow car into left basket, pause for settling, then begin the left-arm reset with open jaws. Keep right at origin.
